Is this PR still relevant? Any recent updates? Anyone making progress?

This has been blocked for over a year on Eric Wieser's "I think pulling through comm is going to cause trouble in an eventual bimodule world, where you can't commute without also moving to MulOpposite" comment in this thread https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/287929-mathlib4/topic/Right.20actions.20on.20tensor.20products.20.28again.29/near/522212704. In an attempt to move it forwards I have changed the definition of the right smul in the PR now. My answer to Eric's question is that Algebra R A should not imply RSMul R A. Eric also talked about a possible bimodule world, and I got an LLM to prototype a design in FLT#1152 .
Sorry for dropping the ball for so long; the new diff in rightAlgebra looks reasonable enough to me, and a slight improvement over the status quo.
I've left a comment on that thread and on the PR
